llm.summary: This appears to be a Kraken.io connector with disclosed image-processing behavior, but users should understand that optimization may send images to Kraken.io.

dimensions.detail: The documented image optimization action fits Kraken.io’s normal service purpose, though the read/search-oriented description should more clearly disclose processing and upload behavior.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger wording for any Kraken.io request is broad and could route casual mentions to the skill, but no artifact-backed evidence shows hidden or automatic high-impact execution.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No concerning install mechanism or package-install behavior was provided in the reviewed telemetry.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network/API use and transfer of user-provided images are proportionate for a Kraken.io optimization connector when invoked intentionally.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No evidence of persistence, background workers, privilege escalation, credential harvesting, or local profile/session access was identified.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install if you intend to use Kraken.io through Codex. Before optimizing images, confirm which files will be sent to Kraken.io and make sure you are comfortable sharing that content with the service; avoid invoking it for casual Kraken.io discussion unless you mean to run the connector.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: The image optimization capability is purpose-aligned for Kraken.io, but it should be treated as processing/upload behavior rather than read-only search.
[SQP-1] expected: Broad routing language is a usability and consent concern, but by itself it does not show malicious or purpose-mismatched behavior.
